name: Home Lab
short_description: Status and one privileged action for a self-hosted home lab node. Allowlisted users only.
description:
Read-only status for a self-hosted Ubuntu node: uptime, load, memory and disk, read straight from /proc. One privileged action, scoped to a single service. /ask sends your question and those status figures to a model.

Only allowlisted user ids get a reply. Everything else is refused and logged.
